svg.text: Token studies: Decay on a base, and warning-sign threat ladders
To scale, 8 px = 1 mm. Threat in gunmetal plastic; Decay in rust-brown plastic. The pieces first; the icons will follow them.
1 · Decay as a token (every option on a round base, 11 mm)
a hull panel split down the middle, standing on its base
the two halves fold apart like a broken hatch
reads from above, but low and plain from the side
the round-1 study: a post and foot give a clear 'this way up'
B · Sign plates on a foot
no post: chunkier, sturdier, the shape is the whole piece; the foot shows which way is up
C · Bollards with a sign face
a hazard bollard you place in the room: escalates by height and by sign; knocked over reads well
the signal-lamp idea merged in: a warning shape with a lamp lens, the Failure's lamp blazing
one sign that grows and gains marks (! / !! ): simplest to learn, weakest silhouettes
